content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Because these symptoms are paroxysmal, continuous rhythm correlation over an extended monitoring period is required to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events. The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial."}
